title: The Two Trees: Life and Death as Corresponding Five-Membered Organisms
description: Life and Death are not vague opposites but precisely corresponding structures, each with the same five members. The Beautiful Tree's fruit is Jesus the Radiance and its members are the five faculties (reflection, counsel, teaching, thought, mind) functioning as a ladder of ascent through First Man and Third Ambassador to the God of Truth. The Bitter Tree mirrors them member-for-member as a chain of descent terminating in the bolos. The two trees do not arise from one another, but from two distinct origins.
